tasks.title: Console accepts patched addresses in forms and stored-channel reads before the API writer updates
tasks.spec: ## Repository: console, R7, both Tests lists and all Completion evidence; Rollout step 2, M2, Releases/deploy/rollback and Rows stored before the patch; Security impact; Performance impact; Acceptance evidence 5-8. After contract merges, pin its full main patch merge SHA (2.5.1 or next free patch) and regenerate bun.lock. First add three parseChannelForm defect tests and two readNotifyChannels M2 tests on the old c5ce668 pin; each fails by assertion, existing valid form and webhook-read controls pass on both pins. M2 checks the stored padded address is ok and unchanged, trailing text invalid for the whole view. Preserve errors mapping and production source. This reader merges before api. Record dev-row validation/remediation and deployment/rollback rules from Rollout order. Include full check/browser/Compose CI, manual changed-form evidence and five-per-side test CPU A/B.

acceptance.expected: On patch, 0 fail. Form: smtp_client_name pulse_console gives isOk false and channel.smtp.clientName: must be a host name; from Ops <ops@example.test> trailing gives false; from Ops < ops@example.test > gives true. M2: fake API notifyChannelsView with the literal database email record from the section gives kind ok and from === "Ops < ops@example.test >"; the same view with "Ops <ops@example.test> trailing" gives {kind:"failed",failure:{kind:"invalid"}}. Each of the five new cases fails by assertion on the old 2.4.0 pin (M2 gives invalid and ok), then passes on the patch; the existing pulse.example.com/Pulse <pulse@example.com> form and webhook channels-view controls pass on both pins. Focused coverage status is not its test result.
exit 0; package.json and committed bun.lock agree.
exit 0; the repository's lint, typecheck and full test suite pass with the existing 80% line coverage gate; never weaken shared configuration.

Both files pin the same full patch merge SHA; CONTRACT_PATCH_SHA is the full 40-character merge SHA independently obtained from the merged contract child PR implementing R1-R6 on main (2.5.1 on today's main, or the next free patch literal named in that PR); the lockfile resolution matches that commit.

acceptance.expected: exit 0; existing Chromium browser checks pass (package.json:19; AGENTS.md:24; ci.yml:291,306,308).
exit 0; production source and the existing contract-error mapping stay unchanged.
Before committing, only package.json, bun.lock, src/notification-form.test.ts and src/runtime-read.test.ts are changed or untracked.

exit 0; console check, browser and deploy-dev pass. deploy-dev starts pulse-deploy main's dev stack and runs E2E_CONSOLE_FLOW=two-factor bash e2e/console-setup.sh dev/compose.yaml (ci.yml:231,279). A failure where console follows the spec is a deploy defect: hold; never edit deploy or weaken its check.

Fixture console starts (AGENTS.md:25); manually attempt an email channel save with clientName pulse_console, observe channel.smtp.clientName: must be a host name, record command/result in the PR and stop the fixture. PULSE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000 bun start is the alternative in the section.

Performance impact: run five samples per side, alternating origin/main and branch with the matching dependencies installed; all full test runs pass. Report median user + system seconds per side and their delta in the PR, never substitute wall time. Console has no budget key; still report the few added cases' CPU delta. A test CPU increase above 0.5 s is reported as a finding (Acceptance evidence 8).

Records the three old-pin form assertion failures, both M2 failures (invalid/ok), unchanged valid controls passing on both and all passing on patch; independently verified full patch merge SHA/lockfile; check/browser/deploy-dev and manual command/error; test CPU A/B medians/delta and findings. Includes applicable Security impact dependency-pin/input-validation review. States console merges before api; an old api returns 422 to the padded address until its last bump. Carries the dev pre-activation check (GET /admin/notify/channels through the new validator; fix with PUT or DELETE any named old-invalid row), release/deploy rule (api/console/notify images contain patch together), and rollback rule (unpad stored addresses and wait for notify sync before rolling readers back). Do not edit deploy or live data as part of this code task.
